# Tricky strings for the differential text test (scripts/textdiff.sh): each drawn by mbui (shaped by the host, each
# cluster rasterized on its own into the atlas, laid out by src/ui) and by the platform's own text drawing at the same
# font, size and place, then compared (advance, ink box, pixels).
#
# In the spirit of HarfBuzz's and Chromium's text test corpora (ligatures, kerning, clusters, marks, scripts), written
# for this file: no text is taken from elsewhere.
#
#   id | variants | text
# variants (default S): S sizes 11, 15, 20 and 28; r 15 alone; b bold 15; B bold 28; i italic 15; m the code face 15.
# Escapes in text: \t a tab, \u{XXXX} a code point, \\ a backslash.

# ---- ligatures: one glyph for several letters (the "f ɭex" of a701b26)
liga-flex | Sbi | flex
liga-fi | Sbi | fi fl ff ffi ffl fj ft
liga-words | Sbim | office flexible affluent shuffle waffle fjord
liga-caps | S | Flexbox Fifth Office FFI
liga-precomposed | S | \u{FB00} \u{FB01} \u{FB02} \u{FB03} \u{FB04} (precomposed)
liga-after-space | r | a fl b fi c ffl d
liga-th | ri | the theatre Th tt

# ---- kerning: pairs moved closer than their advances say
kern-pairs | SB | AV To Wa LT Ty Yo P. F, VA
kern-words | Sb | AVATAR WAVE Today LTV Typo
kern-quotes | S | “Wo” ‘Ta’ T. Y, L’ r.
kern-digits | r | 11 71 17 1.1 7,7

# ---- figures: proportional and tabular
digits | Sbm | 0123456789
digits-runs | S | 1111 8888 0000 1010
digits-money | S | ¥1,234.56 $7,890 €0.99 12:30 50% −3
digits-fractions | r | ½ ¼ ¾ 1⁄2 x² H₂O

# ---- Han, kana, Hangul with Latin and CJK punctuation
cjk-mixed | Sb | 你好，世界。Hello「mbui」、测试
cjk-fullwidth-space | S | 全角　空格　在这里
cjk-brackets | S | （括号）【方括号】《书名号》〈单〉
cjk-dots | S | 等一下……好的——走吧！？
cjk-numbers | S | 共3条消息，第12页，100%完成
cjk-latin-words | r | 用mbui写UI，在Android上跑
cjk-italic | i | 斜体的汉字和Latin混排
cjk-ja | S | 日本語のテキスト、カタカナ。ｶﾀｶﾅ
cjk-fullwidth-latin | r | ＡＢＣ１２３！？
hangul | S | 안녕하세요 한국어 텍스트
hangul-jamo | r | \u{1100}\u{1161}\u{11A8} \u{1112}\u{1161}\u{11AB} (conjoining jamo)

# ---- emoji: sequences that are one cluster
emoji-basic | S | 😀 👍 🎉 🙏 🔥
emoji-zwj-family | S | 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 👩‍👩‍👦 👨‍👨‍👧
emoji-zwj-other | r | 🧑‍💻 👩‍🚀 🏳️‍🌈 🐻‍❄️ ❤️‍🔥
emoji-skin | S | 👍🏻 👍🏽 👍🏿 🧑🏾‍💻 👋🏼
emoji-flags | S | 🇨🇳 🇯🇵 🇺🇸 🇬🇧 🇫🇷
emoji-keycaps | S | 1️⃣ #️⃣ *️⃣ 0️⃣
emoji-vs16 | S | ☺️ ☺ ✈️ ✈ ♥️ ♥ ©️ ©
emoji-in-text | Sb | ok 👌 done ✅ 好的 🙏 next →

# ---- combining marks: one cluster, a base and what sits on it
marks-e | S | e\u{301} é e\u{300} è (decomposed, precomposed)
marks-stack | S | n\u{303}\u{303} a\u{300}\u{301}\u{302} o\u{308}\u{304}
marks-vietnamese | Sbi | Tiếng Việt: ễ ặ ở ữ ợ ầ
marks-vietnamese-nfd | S | e\u{302}\u{303} a\u{306}\u{323} u\u{31B}\u{303}
marks-below | r | ḍ ṇ ṭ ẹ ọ ụ
marks-enclosing | r | a\u{20DD} 1\u{20E3} x\u{20E0}
marks-alone | r | \u{301} \u{308} (marks without a base)

# ---- Thai: marks above and below, no spaces between words
thai | S | ภาษาไทย สวัสดีครับ
thai-marks | S | กี่ ปั้น น้ำ ฤๅ ญี่ปุ่น
thai-sara-am | r | น้ำ ทำ กำลัง

# ---- right to left

hebrew | S | שלום עולם

# ---- Indic: conjuncts, reordered vowel signs, reph
deva | S | नमस्ते दुनिया

# ---- other scripts
greek-cyrillic | Sb | Ελληνικά Русский текст
latin-extended | S | Ąę Łódź Ærøskøbing ß ẞ Ŋ ĳ
math-symbols | S | ≤ ≥ ≠ ± × ÷ → ⇒ ∞ √ ∑
quotes-dashes | S | “quotes” ‘single’ — en–dash … «guillemets»

# ---- spaces and tabs
tabs | Sm | a\tb\tc
tab-lead | rm | \tindented
tab-mid | rm | name:\tvalue\tend
spaces-runs | S | a  b   c    d
spaces-special | r | a\u{A0}b a\u{2009}b a\u{200B}b a\u{AD}b a\u{3000}b
zero-width | r | a\u{200D}b a\u{200C}b a\u{2060}b

# ---- long and unbreakable
long-word | S | Pneumonoultramicroscopicsilicovolcanoconiosis
long-url | r | https://example.com/a/very/long/path/without/any/spaces?query=string&x=1
long-cjk | r | 这是一段很长的没有空格的中文文字用来测试一行放不下的时候会怎么样

# ---- styles
code | Sm | fn main() { let x = 0x1F; } // ok
code-ops | m | -> => != <= >= :: ++ && ||
caps | Sb | ALL CAPS TEXT WAVY
italic-mix | i | Italic with fi, ffl and AV
bold-mix | bB | Bold with fi, ffl and AV
